newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Sanctuary Woods Q1 results.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Sanctuary Woods Q1 results.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers) NOTE: The net income reported in the June 1996 quarter was due to the $897,260 gain recognized on the sale of the Company's studio in Victoria, British Columbia. The 1996 quarter also included approximately $1.2 million in gross sales of entertainment titles including the sale of rights to certain titles for $580,000. The Company discontinued development of entertainment titles in April 1996.

On August 14, 1997 Sanctuary Woods announced the completion of its merger with Theatrix Interactive, Inc. The earnings results for the quarter ending June 30, 1997 reflect those of anctuary Woods Multimedia Corporation and not of the combined companies.
